description: This source file defines the MidiScope class, a virtual MIDI device service for Android that logs MIDI messages using a ScopeLogger. It manages MIDI input receivers, handles device connection events, and interacts with MidiFramer and related classes.

classes.name: MidiScope
classes.description: A virtual MIDI device service that logs MIDI messages and handles device connection status changes.

classes.name: MyReceiver
classes.description: An inner class extending MidiReceiver that forwards received MIDI data to a framer for processing.

methods.name: onGetInputPortReceivers
methods.description: Returns an array containing the input MIDI receiver.

methods.name: setScopeLogger
methods.description: Sets the ScopeLogger and initializes the MIDI framer with a logging receiver if the logger is not null.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Called when MIDI data is sent; forwards data to the MidiFramer for processing.

methods.name: onDeviceStatusChanged
methods.description: Handles device connection status changes, logs connection or disconnection events.
